data.name: Hermes
data.gender_notes: Hermes is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Hermes is recorded in name-lists as “Messenger of the gods”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Hermes expresses “Messenger of the gods”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hermes total 32, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: ארמס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: ארמס הוא שם המקור ביוונית, אך בעברית הוא מתורגם כמלאך אלוהים, ומשמש גם כשם עברי למלאך המטיל אימה

in_greek.name: Ἑρμῆς
in_greek.long_meaning: Ἑρμῆς ἐστιν ὄνομα Ἑλληνικὸν τοῦ ἀγγέλου τοῦ Θεοῦ, καὶ ἐν τῇ Καινῇ Διαθήκῃ ἀναφέρεται ὡς ὁ ἄγγελος τοῦ Κυρίου

in_latin.name: Hermes
in_latin.long_meaning: Hermes est nomen Graecum, quod in Latinam linguam translatum est, et significat angelum Dei, qui in Nova Testamenta saepe memoratur
